zones.name: London Congestion Charge zone
zones.geometrySource: OSM relation 3045928 (London Congestion Charge), simplified to 15 m - UNVERIFIED against TfL
zones.notes: Watched along its edge, like every charging area. Hours and rates must be confirmed against TfL before relying on them. £18 paid on the day or in advance, £21 if paid by midnight of the third day after travel. No charge between Christmas and New Year. Charges from the operator, checked 2026-09-20. Source: tfl.gov.uk.

zones.name: London Ultra Low Emission Zone
zones.geometrySource: OSM London LEZ boundary (relation 3937563), main ring only, simplified to 150 m. The ULEZ has used the LEZ boundary since 29 Aug 2023 - UNVERIFIED against TfL
zones.notes: Large polygon covering most of Greater London. Charges only vehicles that fail the emission standard, which the driver says once, under Menu > Vehicles or when switching it on. £12.50 a day for non-compliant cars, motorcycles, vans up to 3.5t and minibuses up to 5t. Heavier vehicles pay the LEZ charge instead, not this one. Runs 24/7 except Christmas Day. Pay by midnight on the third day after travel. Charges from the operator, checked 2026-09-20. Source: tfl.gov.uk.

zones.name: Birmingham Clean Air Zone
zones.geometrySource: OSM way 770591846 (Birmingham Clean Air Zone: inside the A4540 Middleway, which is not charged), simplified to 15 m - UNVERIFIED against Birmingham City Council
zones.notes: Class D. Charges vehicles that fail the standard: cars, vans, minibuses, taxis and private hire £8; lorries, buses and coaches £50 a day. Motorcycles are not charged. Standards: Euro 4 petrol or Euro 6 diesel for cars, vans, minibuses, taxis and private hire; Euro VI for lorries, buses and coaches. 24/7, charged by the day. Pay up to 6 days before, or by 11:59pm on the sixth day after, through GOV.UK. Class, vehicles charged, hours and payment window from GOV.UK (Driving in a Clean Air Zone), checked 2026-09-25. Daily amounts from published summaries of the council schemes, checked the same day; the penalty is the usual English CAZ figure and is not confirmed for this zone. Confirm every figure on the council site before relying on it.

zones.name: Blackwall and Silvertown tunnels

charge.variesBy: vehicle class and time of day

zones.geometrySource: Banks and tunnel bores traced from OpenStreetMap on 2026-10-15: Blackwall is ways 5026614 (northbound) and 4420390 (southbound), Silvertown ways 1096402452 (northbound) and 1096402450 (southbound). No circle comes within 230 m of mid-river, where the Thames is 300 m wide. Point is the label only - UNVERIFIED on the road
zones.notes: Two separate tunnels sharing a chargeGroup. Reported daily-cap behaviour across the pair is inconsistent across sources - confirm with TfL directly before relying on the dedupe rule. GPS is lost inside the tunnels, so both are watched on their banks, and going into a bore at its mouth counts even if the GPS never comes back on the far side. Cars and small vans £3.50 peak, £1.50 off-peak on Auto Pay; medium vans £6.50 peak; HGVs £10.00 peak, £5.00 off-peak. Peak is 06:00-10:00 northbound and 16:00-19:00 southbound on weekdays. Charges from the operator, checked 2026-09-20. Source: tfl.gov.uk. TfL has announced an increase from 21 September 2026 - re-check these after that date.

zones.name: Mersey Gateway and Silver Jubilee Bridge
zones.geometrySource: Banks traced from OpenStreetMap on 2026-10-15 over the approaches to both bridges: the Mersey Gateway is ways 532680444 and 192534380, the Silver Jubilee Bridge way 105572903. No circle comes within 290 m of mid-river. Point is the label only - UNVERIFIED on the road
zones.notes: Both bridges are one zone: Merseyflow charges the same for either, and both are watched on the same two banks. Cars and small vans £2.40 unregistered, £2.15 on a registered sticker account, each way. Heavier classes (3.5-12t, over 12t) pay more; those figures are not confirmed here, so no range is shown. Charges from the operator, checked 2026-09-20. Source: merseyflow.co.uk.

zones.name: Tyne Tunnels
zones.geometrySource: Banks and tunnel bores traced from OpenStreetMap on 2026-10-16: the original Tyne Tunnel, now northbound, is ways 4937248, 446430760 and 446430759; the New Tyne Tunnel, southbound, ways 54571935, 232003703 and 232003702. Each bank holds 3.5 to 4 km of the A19, and no circle comes within 500 m of mid-river. Point is the label only - UNVERIFIED on the road
zones.notes: Barrier-free (Tyne Pass): cameras read the number plate and the toll is paid afterwards, or taken from a pre-paid account. Charged each way, every passage. Cars, vans and buses under 3.5 tonnes £2.60; over 3.5 tonnes £5.20; motorcycles free with an exemption account. 10% off with a pre-paid account (from £2.34). Pay by midnight the day after crossing; unpaid, an Unpaid Toll Charge Notice of £30 plus the toll, rising to £60 plus the toll after 14 days. Charged around the clock. Charges from the operator, checked 2026-10-16. Source: tt2.co.uk.

zones.name: Humber Bridge
zones.geometrySource: Banks traced from OpenStreetMap on 2026-10-16: the bridge is ways 3996808 (southbound) and 4063883 (northbound), on the A15. Each bank holds over 3 km of its approaches: the A15 and A1077 at Barton; the A15, the A1105 from Hull, the A164 from Beverley and the A63 link at Hessle. No circle comes within 870 m of mid-river, where the estuary is over 2 km wide. Point is the label only - UNVERIFIED on the road
zones.notes: Barrier-free since the Humber Bridge Toll system went live on 2 February 2026: the toll booths closed and the toll is paid afterwards, in advance, or from an account. Charged in both directions. Cars, small vans and caravans £2.00 (£1.50 with an account); 3.5 to 7 tonnes, minibuses, buses and coaches £5.00 (£4.00); 3 axles or more over 7.5 tonnes £15.00 (£12.00); motorcycles and approved concessions free. Pay by midnight the day after crossing; unpaid, an Unpaid Toll Notification adds a £25 admin fee to the toll. Charged around the clock, seven days a week. Charges from the operator's toll prices, ways to pay and payment window pages, read as archived in 2026 since the site refuses automated reading, checked 2026-10-16. Source: humberbridge.co.uk.

zones.name: Rixton and Warburton Toll Bridge
zones.geometrySource: Banks traced from OpenStreetMap on 2026-10-16: the high-level bridge over the Manchester Ship Canal is way 15952431, on Warburton Bridge Road (ways 4685127 and 15952426) between the A57 at Hollins Green and the B5159 at Warburton. The roads either side are short, so each bank holds only about 1.3 km of them, the A57 included; circles stop at least 100 m short of the canal's centreline and 300 m from each other. Point is the label only - UNVERIFIED on the road
zones.notes: Barrier-free since tolls resumed on 5 November 2025: cameras read the number plate and the toll is paid afterwards, by guest payment, a pre-paid account, the app or phone. £1 a passage for a car, van or bus of 3 tonnes or less, at most 2 passages charged per vehicle per calendar day (£2); heavier vehicles need a permit. Local residents (WA3 6, WA13 9, M31 4) pay half with an approved account; motorcycles, cyclists and Blue Badge holders are exempt. Pay by midnight the day after crossing; unpaid, an Unpaid Toll Charge of £30 if paid within 14 days, £60 within 28 days, £100 after. The app reminds of each crossing, so a third in one day is reminded of though not charged. Charges from the operator, checked 2026-10-16. Source: warburtontollbridge.co.uk.
